result.topic_en: Calculations for the electric distribution on several parallel cylinders (circles in cross-section) using inversion in circles: image charges with masses m and positions b, the reflection map $(y_1-c_1)(y-c_1)=a_1^2$, the transformation of $\sqrt{dz/dy}$, a fourth-root function with branch points on the real axis, and a series of reciprocal terms set equal to a quantity.

methods.what: Potential as sum of image charges (method of images) with alternating signs
Inversion (reflection) in circle of radius $a_1$ centered at $c_1$
Image of points under the inversion
Fourth-root algebraic function with branch points $\alpha_i,\gamma_i$ defining z
Linear transformation relations of $z, z'$ under the reflection
Series over group of iterated reflections (Möbius-type terms) summing to $\omega$
